q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis of NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance

## (a) Time left until resolution
Today is August 18, 2026. NVIDIA is scheduled to report Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, after market close. **Time until resolution: 8 days.**

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already provided official guidance for Q2 FY2027: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** (issued May 20, 2026, as their forward guidance). This means the official guidance range is $89.18B to $92.82B.

Since the question asks specifically about "What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release," the answer is asking what guidance number NVIDIA will announce when they report earnings on August 26, 2026. The guidance has already been provided on May 20, 2026, and companies typically either:
1. Reaffirm their previous guidance, or
2. Raise/lower it materially if circumstances have changed significantly

Given that:
- Only 8 days remain until the actual earnings call
- NVIDIA provided specific guidance ($91.0B ± 2%) less than 3 months ago
- No research indicates a major shortfall or upside surprise in Data Center demand since May 2026
- The company appears to be executing well (Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6B significantly beat typical patterns)

The most likely scenario is that NVIDIA either **reaffirms the $91.0B guidance or potentially raises it modestly** (to $92-94B range). A complete abandonment or dramatic change would be unusual so close to earnings.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Significant macro deterioration** in AI/data center demand since May (no evidence of this in research)
- **China-related export restrictions** tightening further (though already excluded from guidance)
- **Demand pullback from major cloud customers** (no signals in current research)
- **Competition from other AI chips** ramping faster than expected
- **Inventory adjustments** at customer level (typically affects following quarter guidance more than current)

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Continued strong demand** from hyperscalers and enterprise AI adoption (consistent with Q1 momentum showing 92% Data Center YoY growth)
- **Vera CPU ramp exceeding expectations** (research mentions opening "$200 billion tab" opportunity)
- **Earlier-than-expected contributions** from new products/architectures
- **Customer pull-forward demand** before potential tariff or regulatory changes
- **Supply chain execution** better than anticipated in May guidance

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

From the research provided:
- Q1 FY2027 guidance was provided on May 20, 2026: **$81.6 billion actual**
- Q2 FY2027 guidance was provided on May 20, 2026: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** ($89.18B–$92.82B)
- Analyst consensus estimates: **$91.846 billion** to **$93.5 billion**

NVIDIA typically reaffirms guidance or raises it modestly when executing well. Historical pattern shows the company rarely cuts guidance sharply with <2 weeks to earnings. The $91.0B guidance from May sits well below some analyst consensus estimates ($93.5B), suggesting room for a modest upward revision is plausible.

---

## Reasoning on the probability distribution:

The guidance range of $89.18B–$92.82B is narrow. Given:
1. Only 8 days until earnings (little time for major surprises)
2. Official guidance was already set in May at $91.0B ± 2%
3. Analyst consensus slightly above that at $91.8–$93.5B
4. Strong Q1 momentum (20% QoQ growth in total revenue, 92% Data Center YoY)
5. No negative signals in current research

The most probable outcomes are:
- **Reaffirm at $91.0B** (~35% probability)
- **Modest raise to $92–94B** (~45% probability)
- **Material raise above $94B** (~15% probability)
- **Cut below $91B** (~5% probability)

The median expected guidance should be near **$92.0–93.0 billion**, with most probability mass between $90.5B and $94.5B.

---

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA is scheduled to report its Q2 FY2027 earnings on August 26, 2026, after market close, covering the period that ended in late July 2026 [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). For Q2 FY2027, NVIDIA's own guidance, provided on May 20, 2026, is for revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/), [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026/). Analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.846 billion [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors), with some aggregators pegging it closer to $93.5 billion [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).

NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 revenue, reported on May 20, 2026, was $81.6 billion, an 85% increase year-over-year and 20% quarter-over-quarter [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% year-over-year [ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026). The company's new Vera CPU is expected to open a "brand new $200 billion tab for Nvidia" [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).
